title: Rory and the Silver Clover Hill
verses:
The sun tumbled down past the edge of the hill,
The breezes of evening grew cozy and still.
Then Rory stepped softly across the warm ground,
Without making even the tiniest sound.

High over the treetops flew Nia to glide,
While Ricky came bounding right up to her side.
He carried a feather of silver and blue,
That shone in the mist as the evening stars grew.

Ahead on the slope was a carpet of green,
The silkiest clover the friends had all seen.
Then Tilly swept pathways with slow, steady feet,
To make a big hollow so cozy and sweet.

And Benny lay down like a sheltering wall,
To cradle his friends so no shadows would fall.
Then Psittaco settled inside of a leaf,
And rested his chin in a sigh of relief.

Then Rory curled down in the soft purple glow,
And hummed a sweet tune that was rocking and slow.
While Ricky stopped bouncing and closed his brown eyes,
Beneath the calm stars in the slumbering skies.

The silver leaves nodded and dreamed in the deep,
As all of the valley was drifting to sleep.
The moonlight gave Rory a kiss on his head,
Goodnight to the dinosaurs snug in their bed.
